title: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”: this Bible was written before any of us were here, and it was written so that we would learn from the examples in it. We read about the Israelites going into captivity after captivity after captivity, committing sin after sin after sin, and we can see where that has gotten us.

We also read about redemption, so we have to take those examples too. When the Israelites came out of captivity, what did they have to do? Keep the commandments.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope”: the hope is that a Saviour is coming to redeem the children of Israel. The things written aforetime are examples for us to learn from; that is why, later on, Korah’s company, Theudas and Judas of Galilee are read: we need to learn from those examples.

precepts.why:
Paul blesses “the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort.” The God of all comfort: and where do we find the comfort of God? In this Bible. That is the “comfort of the scriptures” in Romans 15:4.

He is the one “Who comforteth us in all our tribulation”: Christ comforts us in all our tribulations, “that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble.” Our people are in trouble today, absolutely. So what are we supposed to comfort them with? This Bible. We have to let our people know there is a better way: don’t go to the left, don’t go to the right, go to this Bible, the straight and narrow path.

sense.text:
“That ye all speak the same thing”: when did we all speak the same things? In the time of King David and King Solomon, when we ruled the nations. “And that there be no divisions among you”: at one time we were unified, and we put the heathen, the other nations, in subjection. Are we unified today?

“But that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.” Imagine us being perfectly joined together as one man. That is called unity.

precepts.why:
Think about this on the Sabbath day, when we come to hear the word of the Lord: “when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.”

As one man. Imagine how much we could get done if we thought as one man, all of us with the same mind, the same spirit and the same judgment that 1 Corinthians 1:10 calls for.

“Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.” Endeavouring is trying hard, striving: keep the unity no matter what. Brothers are going to offend brothers and sisters are going to offend sisters. Get over it. Get over your emotions and that meekly spirit; there are bigger things to worry about than your feelings, because every one of us, one way or another, is going to be offended at one time or another. So the hell what? Get over it.

“There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling; One Lord, one faith, one baptism, One God and Father of all.” Only one body and one spirit: that is the same mind and the same judgment of 1 Corinthians 1:10.

“Till we all come in the unity of the faith”: the faith in Christ, keeping the commandments with faith in Christ, “and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man”. That is the one man again: we come together as one man, “unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ”, because our example is Jesus the Christ, the one we are supposed to be like.

And all this unity we strive and endeavour to keep is “For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ”. That is what it is about: the perfecting of your people, the repentance of your people, and doing the work of God in this ministry.

sense.text: This is what happened to all that unity. “Why do the heathen rage”: why do the other nations rage? “And the people imagine a vain thing”: the people, the coons among our people, imagine a vain thing.

“The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together”: the rulers of the earth. They are all in the news right now with the Epstein files released, evil with little children, blood, even cannibalism, trickling down from twenty, thirty, forty years ago: Prince Andrew, Trump, Clinton. If we did what they did we would be under the jail, and they are still walking around free. These are the kings of the earth, and nothing is going to happen to them.

They take counsel “against the Lord”: against what we are doing in this building, the teaching of the commandments with faith in Christ, against black Christ, against the word of God. “And against his anointed”: if they are against Christ, they are against his followers too, the soldiers of Christ. Every last one of us in this room is a target. The purple and gold is a problem, and we have a target on our backs.

“Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.” They want to break the unity we have, and cast us away so that we do not come back together. What else is cast away? Our identity, our culture, our heritage, our leaders, our laws: the word of God is cast from you. No unity, no organization, no structure; you are just winging life.

So after 1 Corinthians 1:10 and Ephesians 4 on unity, this is how the unity was cast off. The heathen said, break their bands asunder: separate the northern kingdom from the southern kingdom, remove them from the word of God. Let them be Christians, Muslims, Nile Valley science, Hindu, Buddhist, whatever, but under no circumstances let one rise up and say, you are the children of Israel. You saw what happened when Kyrie Irving, Nick Cannon or Ice Cube did it.
“Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity”: this is the captivity our people were carried into.

“He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country.” Think of a lotto drawing, the balls tossed around in the big jar. That is us on the slave ship, tossed and rocking back and forth all day for months, throwing up, pissing and worse on each other. Imagine that on a plank of wood, God forbid on the bottom plank with no bathroom, and a sister having her period with the blood running down on you. That is how we got here: violently.

“Into a large country”: North America. From the interior of Africa to the west coast of Africa, and into a large country, North America, the last slave trade. “There shalt thou die”: you are going to pine away and die in a new land you do not know, as a slave and a subject.

“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. Even Jeremiah, who was not a wicked man, still went into captivity and had to deal with the same things as all the wicked Israelites.

We have lost our heritage; we discontinued from it. “And I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not”: serving our enemies is one of the curses. Who are our enemies? All the other nations; they are the enemies of God. The Christian does not want to hear that, but here we are unapologetically biblical. Take it up with God.

“For ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.”

precepts.why:
Watch what Jeremiah prayed, knowing how wicked we are: “Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” Far away from his people. I just want to get the hell away from these people, man; I know they look just like me and I grew up with them. That is what Jeremiah is saying.

“For they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men. And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”: do black people do a lot of lying? Yes, we do. “But they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me”.

The black Christian does not know God. Don’t let them fool you: they can quote John 3:16, neither Jew nor Greek, and no weapon formed against me shall prosper all day, but God does not have them; Satan has them. You and Satan are like that old toy, My Buddy. That is why even Jeremiah, the righteous man, went into captivity with the people and discontinued from his heritage.

What is the heritage we lost? “Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.” The law of life is the heritage we discontinued from in Jeremiah 17:4.

Remember, they had to break our bands asunder and separate us. Israelite culture is structured so that if you lose your nationality, you also discontinue from your heritage, because we have a certain way of life as a certain people. When they strip you of your identity, your laws, statutes and commandments follow it out, and you are no longer performing the laws.

Ezra prays, “O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding”. Another word for culture is heritage.

So the culture God gives to our understanding is the same heritage, the law of life, that Jeremiah 17:4 says we discontinued from.

sense.text:
“If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.” Your right hand is your strength, the hand you work with. Jerusalem is our homeland, where we go and keep the laws and keep the feasts. If you forget Jerusalem, you forget the laws, statutes and commandments, and it is like forgetting how to do the very work you know how to do.

If you forget your identity, your way of life goes with it.

“If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth”. If we do not remember the Lord and his laws, statutes and commandments, our tongue cleaves to the roof of our mouth: we cannot speak, plain and simple, so we cannot teach his word to our people, because we forgot it.

And if we forgot the word of God, what are we doing? Being dumb ass Christians, making up dumb doctrines. Try to talk with your tongue cleaving to the roof of your mouth and you sound like a level five retard, and everybody looks at you like something is wrong with you. That is how Christians with their doctrines sound to those who know the Bible: stupid and crazy. To other Christians they sound perfectly normal.

“If I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy”: we cannot prefer Jerusalem as our chief joy if we do not know we are the Israelites. Instead we are Christians, ordained ministers out of the white man’s theology schools and seminaries, sounding like idiots.

precepts.why:
“The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.”

From his right hand went the fiery law. So the right hand that forgets her cunning in Psalms 137:5 is tied to the law: forget Jerusalem, forget your identity, and the law that came from the Lord’s right hand, your way of life, goes with it.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.” In plain terms, how did they lift up their heads? They unified and organized against the children of Israel.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: they came together and counselled to put us in slavery and chains, to break our bands asunder and cast our cords aside, to get us away from the Bible and separate us. Call this one Jamaican, Haitian, American; give them a bunch of different religions too. Now the new one is FBA, foundational black American, who hate the other eleven tribes. Instead of turning that anger on Esau, who took your identity, you blame the other tribes in the same circumstances you are in.

“And consulted against thy hidden ones.” The hidden ones are Israel: our identity is hidden. We are not called Israel any more, but black, Negroes, Afro-Americans, African-Americans. “They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” That is the crafty counsel that made us forget Jerusalem.

“Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me”: black people, the northern kingdom too, are the most spiritual people on the planet. We love God, we love Jesus. “But have removed their heart far from me”: our people have removed the laws of God, this Bible, far from them. The word of God is not in our people’s spirit; it is void, and what has replaced it is Satan, through the so-called white man, and God has to separate you from him.

“And their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men”: the way you understand how to fear the Lord was taught to you by the white man. Christianity says the laws of God are done away with, so our women are whoring, our brothers are selling drugs, baby daddies and baby mamas, and nobody fears anything. If our people had fear, this room would be full with a line out the door to hear the word of the Lord and keep the Sabbath day.

That is a people who do not remember Jerusalem, whose tongue cleaves to the roof of their mouth.

“And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb”. That thou shalt be a Christian. You are not Israel any more, you are not keeping the commandments, you do not have faith in Christ; you have faith in white Jesus and in the white man. Christian dummy.

“And shalt not be to them a reprover”: you are not going to be a reprover to your people, unable to reprove them with this Bible. Instead you will be like Michael Todd and Pastor Pam and the rest of these foolish pastors.

What is supposed to be in your mouth? “This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth”: the Bible, God’s laws. That is what belongs in your mouth. “But thou shalt meditate therein day and night”.

But because we have been so wicked, he made our tongue cleave to the roof of our mouth. Now as Christians we sound like idiots trying to break the Bible down, saying strange doctrines, like the burning mountain being a meteorite.

sense.text:
“For the leaders of this people cause them to err”: who are the leaders in the black community today? Your black leaders have you fighting for Palestinians and fighting all kinds of stupid battles. “And they that are led of them are destroyed”: you black Christians led by them are destroyed, and our people are so destroyed they don’t even know it, kept with a warm fuzzy feeling every Sunday.

The pastors are the new taskmasters. They are sent out by Esau; they learned the doctrines from Esau and bring them into your community, and you think you are supposed to be suffering and struggling while he pulls up in the Benz and you give him your last.

The results of our Christian leaders teaching us Christianity are on display: we love the people who enslaved us, destroyed us and took our nationality. Black people rooting hard for Trump at his inauguration, while he posts a video of the Obamas as monkeys; this is why you cannot trust all black people, they will sell you out quick. A man who says he is a Christian before he is black, and that black is a construct; tell the white man black is a construct, he put us in chains, and it was no construct then. A sister letting a boy call her the N-word and call him master. A father in South Fulton putting antifreeze in his eighteen-day-old baby’s milk so he would not pay child support; he is a Christian whether he goes to church or not. Women supporting aborting black boys. And there is no law, because the laws are done away with.

Esau beat this man-made religion into us, starting with Pope Nicholas V, whose bull Dum Diversas authorized the king of Portugal to subjugate and conquer the Saracens and pagans in African territory. Without him and Pope Alexander VI there would be no such thing as an African-American, a Jamaican, a Haitian, a Puerto Rican. Christians did this to us, and now we revel in it and follow their laws and ways of life.

These are your leaders that cause you to err: Eddie Long crowned a king by a white man who holds the mic and calls everyone else common; a pastor at Perfecting Church shaming a grandmother whose seed of a thousand and thirty-five dollars was not what he asked for, embarrassing her in front of the grandson she brought to church; a pastor teaching people about relationships who never knew how to have one, whose past relationships were with men and women, and who is now charged by a young man with twelve years of sexual abuse; a black pastor saying that if Jesus is black heaven is a ghetto; pastors who never preach on gluttony; a bishop’s wife who says there is no manual for how a bishop’s wife should be when there is a Bible; a preacher saying Christ was out of order 85% of his life, which is blasphemy, and no black Christian walked out. The leaders have the black community living in hell: baby daddies and baby mamas, drugs, gang violence, shootings on the block, adultery. That is destroyed.

precepts.why:
“Israel hath cast off the thing that is good”: the laws of God, this Bible. “The enemy shall pursue him” because of that.

“They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not”: you set up leaders, but they are not of the Lord. “Of their silver and their gold have they made them idols”: you make these so-called leaders your idols and follow them wholeheartedly. Pastor says give a thousand dollars and you say, I’ll work it out, I’ll get you your money. That is cold pimping.

“That they may be cut off”: and now we are cut off. That is the leaders causing the people to err, and the people led of them destroyed.

A boxer says there is no number that can get him back in the ring, then says for a hundred million dollars, you can have my soul, and he is dead serious. That is the result of four hundred years with Esau: you would sell out your mama and your children, you would do anything. He said it out loud, but the majority of black celebrities, rappers and singers think like that. No dignity, no morals: what will you stand for if everything is about money?

“For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?” Esau gives you whatever you want: the riches, the connections, the power. But to get it you lose your own soul.

“Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?” These celebrities give it up; Amalek takes it. Your Jay-Zs, 50 Cents, Mariah Careys, all of them, have to give in order to receive. That is what the destroyed state of the people led by these leaders looks like.

“Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.” The oppressors are the popes who sent the Christian nations to conquer Africa, and the people who enslaved us. Choose none of our oppressors’ ways.

But tomorrow at eleven o’clock Sunday morning our people will be in church getting a good dose of the doctrine of the man who enslaved them and turned them into African-Americans, Jamaicans and Haitians, and they cannot wait to go learn about a good Jesus. That is choosing the oppressor’s ways, led by leaders who cause them to err.

sense.text: Korah, the son of Levi, with Dathan, Abiram and On, sons of Reuben, “took men: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown”. These were men who had a name in Israel. They were not nobodies and not common. What did they have? Influence: they could influence the congregation.

“And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you”. Who are you to be above us, Moses? Here are leaders rising up, and now we see the results of these leaders.

precepts.why:
Moses said, “If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.” If these men die a common death like everybody else does, the Lord did not send me. “But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up”, “then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.”

“The ground clave asunder that was under them: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.” They “went down alive into the pit”.

“And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them”: they saw what happened and were in fear, saying, “Lest the earth swallow us up also.” “And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.” That is the result of following leaders the Lord did not send.

The first scripture of the class was Romans 15:4: what was written aforetime was written for our learning, and we need to learn from these examples. The apostles were brought to the council, and Gamaliel stood up: “Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.”

Then he gives examples. “For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves”: four hundred men joined themselves to a man who came across as a leader. “Who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.”

“After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.” Like Korah’s company, the ones led by false leaders perish with them.

sense.text: “The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool”. The prophet, your Christian pastor, your reverend, your minister, is a fool. “The spiritual man is mad”: madness is what comes out of them, and following them, that same foolishness gets into your spirit. “For the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.”

“The prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.” He hates the Lord. These pastors do not love the Lord; their god is money, money, money. They know you are indoctrinated with white Jesus, Christianity and Sunday worship, and they know the right things to say to motivate that money out of your pocket and into theirs. They are not stupid; they are motivational speakers. Juanita Bynum charges over a thousand dollars for a prayer class, and she can be so bold because Christians do not know the Bible.

“They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah”: Eddie Long flying boys out of the country, and worse among the big pastors. “Therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.” He is going to remember these leaders’ iniquity.
“Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.”

“Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them”. The pastors help keep the confusion and the sin in the black community going. They keep Ephraim separated from Judah; our bands are cast asunder and they are not bringing it back. “Behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.”

precepts.why:
“For the land is full of adulterers”, like Jamal Bryant. “The pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil”: you live in the worst neighbourhoods now. “And their force is not right”: you are not right in your spirit and not right in your doctrine.

“For both prophet and priest are profane”. That is what God said. They are not after the Lord and not teaching his Bible; they teach prosperity and that you do not have to keep the laws of God. The result of teaching that the laws are done away with is a people of adulterers, gangbangers, murderers and debauchery. “Yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.”

“I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies”: Jamal Bryant with three or four baby mamas, Donnie McClurkin doing all kinds of evil with men and women and now being sued for it. These Christian pastors walk in lies.

“They strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness”. When Jamal Bryant was shown he was wrong about his wife’s dress, he did not say, the Bible says a woman should dress modestly, I repent; he doubled down. So when we tell people on the street, sis, you can’t wear pants, brother, you can’t sell drugs, they double down just like him, and none returns from his wickedness: the Lord did away with that, you twisted the scripture, I have to study for myself.

“They are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.” “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.”

The pastors are furthering the scattering of the children of Israel instead of bringing us together, so look what Christ had to say: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations”. Why all nations? Because we are scattered in all nations, our bands cut asunder.

“Baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you”: gathering the flock the pastors scattered, by teaching them to keep what Christ commanded.

“Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?” They were offended because Christ was cutting the Pharisees.

“Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.” These pastors, these so-called men of the cloth, have to go; they are going to be rooted up. “Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.” Leave these lying churches alone if they cannot repent.

“There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls”. These pastors devour your souls. “They have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows”.

“Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane”. They blurred the lines: there is no right or wrong now, just a grey area in the middle, a little evil, a little good. “Neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths”.

“Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey”: the black Christian congregants are the prey. “To shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain”: money, money, money. They are covetous.

sense.text: “Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers. Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?” That hellfire is coming for those Christ is speaking to.

“Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city”. That is us: the black Christians in our community persecuting the prophets who come to tell them the truth.

Where? In their synagogues, meaning their churches. That is the church blitz, right here in the Bible: in order for that to happen, we have to go to the church. We go to these churches and they put hands on us and pull guns on us. These are Christians with the love of Jesus, and we come with the same Bible they have in their church and they want to kill us for it.

precepts.why:
“Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.”

That is the problem. The white man would take away their place, their riches and their platforms and make them commoners, so they have to follow Rome; today they follow America’s doctrines and cannot speak the truth. So Caiaphas says “it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people”: that one man is Christ. The leaders of the synagogue are the ones who kill the one sent to them.

Jesus came to Bethany “where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.” Mary anointed his feet, and Judas Iscariot asked, “Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor? This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag”.

“Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also”. Remember, in the chapter before, after this miracle the Pharisees and scribes said they had to kill Christ before Rome took away their place.

“But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death; Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.” Not just Christ: they had to kill the man he raised from the dead. That is next-level evil. And what are they going to do to us when people believe through us? Put us to death, scourging and persecuting the ones sent to them, as Matthew 23:34 says.

sense.text: “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come”: the day of the Lord. “Except there come a falling away first”: the falling away is Israel going into slavery. “And that man of sin be revealed”: the man of iniquity, the mystery of iniquity. The day of Christ will not come until that man is revealed as the wicked on the earth.

“Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the Lord”: we backslid into sin and we are staying in that sin. “And I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the Lord, and I will not keep anger for ever.”

“Only acknowledge thine iniquity”. That is what we all must do to get the mercy of the Lord: acknowledge our sins, the secret sins, the presumptuous sins, the willful sins, and get rid of them. “That thou hast transgressed against the Lord thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree”: under those green trees we were sacrificing to idols. “And ye have not obeyed my voice”.
“Turn, O backsliding children, saith the Lord; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion”: we are going back to our land.

“And I will give you pastors according to mine heart”: not according to the white man or society, but according to the Lord’s heart, “which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.” We will be able to go into the word of God, break it down and make the people understand it.

Right now our people do not understand the word of God at all; they make things up out of it. Christian pastors come on Clubhouse, we ask them about certain scriptures, and they don’t know it; they are winging it.

The Lord is speaking of the nations: “if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.” You nations are certainly going to drink of that cup of judgments.

“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”: that is Israel, us. “And should ye be utterly unpunished?” We went through slavery here and slavery there, lost our identity, lost our minds. With all the evil the Lord let happen to us, you think nothing is going to happen to you, that we will walk into the kingdom holding hands? No way. If God punished us, his chosen, what is going to happen to you, the white man, the East Indian, the Arabs, the Nilotes? “Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth”: a sword against the nations that put their hands on the children of Israel.

So the Lord wants you to separate from the spirit of America and have the spirit of the Lord, not the spirit of the white man, because judgment is coming for him.

“Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words”: not join together with them, but prophesy against them. “The Lord shall roar from on high”, “he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.”

“For the Lord hath a controversy with the nations”: the Lord has a controversy with you, East Indians, Chinese, Japanese. “He will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword”. Esau and the other nations are prepared for the sword.

precepts.why: “But he saveth the poor from the sword”. Connect it with Jeremiah 25:31, where he gives the wicked to the sword: the poor are the Israelites, and he saves them from that sword. You are going to escape that judgment if you keep the commandments with faith in the Lord and Saviour Jesus the Christ, saved “from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.”

sense.text: “Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out”. This is how the Lord has to separate the black Christian from the white man: when Esau’s light is put out, your head comes right out of the white man’s behind. That is the only way it is going to happen, because our people are too far gone. “And his candle shall be put out with him”: his spirit is gone.
“The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down. For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.”

“The gin shall take him by the heel”, “The snare is laid for him in the ground”. “Terrors shall make him afraid on every side”: terrors shall make Esau afraid on every side, missiles, ICBMs. “His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.”

“It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.” The firstborn of death is Christ. “And it shall bring him to the king of terrors”: Esau, your slave master, the one who taught you how to fear God, brought to the king of terrors.

“Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation. His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off”: his branch is his children. “His remembrance shall perish from the earth”: your slave master, the one who taught you this Bible, shall perish from the earth, “and he shall have no name in the street.”

“He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.” There will come a time when knowing about Esau will be like a bad dream: I had a dream I was in slavery to the basest people on the planet earth. “He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings”: cut off totally; a time is coming when they are not around any more.

“Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.” This is not talking about our people; it is talking about Esau, the wicked on the earth. Destruction is coming to him.

precepts.why:
“He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness”. Remember the crafty counsel of Psalms 83. Everything they did against us is crafty counsel: the way your neighbourhood is set up, redlining, benign neglect, slavery, exploitation, colonization.

So his own counsel casts him down and he is caught in a net by his own feet: “the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.”

Who is the firstborn of death? “That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead”. That is the firstborn of death: Christ, the first raised up. So it is Christ who devours Esau’s strength.

“Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” That is what God said: their memory will be cut off, the same as “His remembrance shall perish from the earth.”

sense.text: We read about judgment, the sword coming for Esau and for the nations. But “he saveth the poor from the sword”: Israel is the poor. “From their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty”: from the hand of these mighty nations.
“So the poor hath hope”: you brothers and sisters have hope that something better is coming than what we are in right now.

“Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth”. That is what we have to rejoice in. A lot of times we take correction as grievous because it doesn’t feel good, but we have to conform our minds to this: happy is the man who takes the correction. Brothers get soft, mealy and yellow about correction; sisters get bitter against the ones who correct them. Get rid of those spirits: man up and woman up. “Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty”.
“For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.” He wounds you with this word, and then he makes you whole again.

“He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee. In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.” All of this is judgment, the sword; he is going to deliver you and redeem you from the power of that sword.

precepts.why: “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.” That fire shall not come near you: in seven troubles no evil shall touch thee.
